sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – our proposal for the price basis from 2027
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to continue working with Werdenfels and agree a longer-term package your team can approve.

We propose EUR 4.60/kg for part:370010, payment within 30 days net and a 36-month contract, with AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. The requirement remains 23,700 kg/year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, with no tooling charges.

Our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

We recognise the cost pressures you described. Could you review the starting price alongside the longer commitment and adjustment mechanism? Your August review noted committee approval for price changes above 2% (doc:20260812-70740-M3). Please involve the colleague who can approve the complete package from the outset and let us have a binding counterproposal. A 24-month term would also be possible.

Thank you for considering it.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Thank you for working through the options with us. We appreciate your team's careful review and would like to find an arrangement that works for Werdenfels as well as for us.

For your review, PPI-C2431 changed by -2.27% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). We recognise that this recent movement can coexist with the annual increase you described. Could you take it into account when reviewing the starting price?

Could you kindly consider one of these complete alternatives? Each price is conditional on its payment term and adjustment clause.

Option A: EUR 5.07/kg, payment within 30 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.
Option B: EUR 5.05/kg, payment within 14 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.
Option C: EUR 5.10/kg, payment within 60 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.

The fixed terms of our enquiry remain unchanged. These are new proposals for your approval. Could you issue the option you can approve as your binding offer? If none works, which term would need to change? We would be pleased to review it together.

Kind regards,
Purchasing

move.subject: Part 370010 – complete package proposal for your approval
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer. We appreciate your move to EUR 5.30/kg at 30 days, and that you accepted the 36-month term with the 5% deadband on AS-14404.

On the alloy component, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We recognise that this recent movement can sit alongside the twelve-month increase you described.

To bridge the remaining gap, we propose one complete package. The price is EUR 5.09/kg with payment within 45 days net. The contract runs 36 months, with AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08. The higher price compared with our 30-day option applies only together with the 45-day payment term. All fixed terms of our enquiry remain unchanged: 23,700 kg/year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, and no tooling charges.

This is a new proposal for your approval. If you can approve it, could you please issue it as your binding offer? If not, please tell us which specific term stands in the way.

Thank you for your continued effort on this.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Regarding our calculation, we have verified the AS-14404 index change you cited and factored it into our calculation. To be completely transparent, our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. Furthermore, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

We accept your proposed 45-day payment term and the 36-month contract duration. Building on this package, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.20 per kg. 

To summarize our Angebot, we present a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Your final offer for part:370010
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your final offer and for the movement you and your team have made. That includes EUR 5.20/kg with 45 days net, the 36-month term and the 5% deadband on AS-14404.

We have reviewed the complete package carefully. Unfortunately, we are not able to accept it as it stands. We respect that this is your final position, so we will not send a further counterproposal.

We appreciate the constructive and courteous way you have handled this negotiation, and we value our working relationship with Werdenfels. If your position on this enquiry changes at any point, we would be glad to hear from you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
